title: Kadaisi Ulaga Por
desc: In the year 2028, a power struggle on an international level creates political turmoil in India. Thamizh, a common man, rises to the occasion to save the day.

title: Paramporul
desc: Aadhi along with a police officer, Maithreyan, embark on a mission to smuggle temple idols in order to make quick money.

title: It's My Life
desc: A father's excessive concern for his son and interference in his life leads to the latter harbouring bitterness towards his overbearing father.

desc: An idle youngster causes chaos in the life of a disciplined banker, whose struggles with his demanding boss are further complicated by the youth's carefree attitude.

desc: A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to reconcile with a former classmate. Upon discovering his companion's dire predicament, he intervenes and becomes a heroic saviour for the entire community.

desc: Chandu, an engineering student, falls in love with Pooja, the girl he mistakenly abducts. However, before he can marry her, he must deal with two warring clans.

title: Tulasi
desc: Tulasi, an educated man, tries to control his violent nature for the sake of his wife and baby child. However, a new enemy forces him to take action and break his family's trust.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

desc: Harsha, a successful expat, is willing to marry any woman his parents choose for him. However, he eventually falls for Vibha, an outspoken lady, who challenges his views on marriage.

title: Nenjamellam Pala Vannam
desc: Two unemployed brothers who do not get along well due to their contrasting natures try to marry the women they love before an accident changes their lives.

desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Milaka
